Name: WHITE_SIGN_COOL_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines the cooldown times for summon signs. Unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time - Normal
Fields.Description: Cooldown time, in seconds, in normal areas without the Dried Finger.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time - Normal (Dried Finger)
Fields.Description: Cooldown time, in seconds, in normal areas with the Dried Finger.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time - Guardian
Fields.Description: Cooldown time, in seconds, in map guardian areas without the Dried Finger.

Fields.Name: Limitation Time - Guardian (Dried Finger)
Fields.Description: Cooldown time, in seconds, in map guardian areas with the Dried Finger.
